_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (the top-level single-file state, NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). Replace 'windows-pc' with the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname of your Windows test machine.
_v0_2_note: winpc-shell was removed in v0.2. All shell / file / process tools moved into winpc-gui. If you have a winpc-shell entry from an older version, delete it.
_v0_4_transport: Migrated SSE -> streamable-http: long tool calls broke SSE keep-alive and yielded -32602 forever. type is now 'http' (Claude Code accepts 'http' or 'streamable-http' as aliases). Endpoint path is /mcp instead of /sse.
_recommended_install: Use scripts/install-agent-side.py --platform winpc-gui --hostname <DEVICE_HOSTNAME> instead of editing this file by hand.
